findings.obligation: P4 failure look of the list
findings.observation: Rejected load yields no connections, so no alert can render; test asserts immediately after the service call and cannot fail for the right reason. Passes today as preserved obligation but is vacuous.
findings.remediation: Drop it or pin something falsifiable (e.g. await the existing could-not-load look, or a failed reload after sign-in does not leave the stale warning as current).
